notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote, MVA1 (OMIM 257300). Allele 1 NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter, nonsense, rs759242053, gnomAD popmax 7.9e-05, DP46 AD21/25 GQ99. Allele 2 NM_001211.6:c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys, missense, novel and absent from gnomAD, SIFT deleterious 0.01, PolyPhen probably damaging 0.997, DP28 AD15/13 GQ99. Both PASS on MANE Select ENST00000287598.11. Trans configuration is inferred from the recessive mechanism, not demonstrated: the alleles lie 10911 bp apart, beyond a read pair, and HaplotypeCaller PGT/PID found no phasing group in BUB1B.

LZTR1 NM_006767.4:c.2244C>G p.Tyr748Ter, heterozygous nonsense, rs1682503990, gnomAD popmax 1.4e-06, DP48 AD24/24 GQ99 PASS. LZTR1 is associated with Noonan syndrome and with schwannomatosis tumour predisposition. Flagged because the proband presents with rhabdomyosarcoma, short stature and failure to thrive, which overlap the RASopathy phenotype, so this may be a modifier rather than an unrelated incidental finding. Recommend clinical review.
